lines.explanation: Agent queried users.conversations, correctly identified the single existing DM (D01AGENTSOPHIE, U_SOPHIE) as the actor's only active private conversation, and reported the count of 1.
Since 1 < 7, the agent correctly took the 'fewer than seven' branch, using the correctly resolved existing-conversation count.

Agent created six new DM conversations, correctly skipping the existing Sophie DM (obligation 1 correctly respected), bringing the total to 7 as required. However, for obligation 2 (alphabetically-first eligible users), the card resolves the correct set by real_name order as Aisha, Artem, Carlos (U_INCOGNITO), Gabriel, Hubert, John. The agent instead sorted by Slack username, producing Aisha, Artem, Gabriel, Hubert, John, Kenji — omitting Carlos entirely and wrongly including Kenji, a user outside the resolved referent set. This is an incorrect target selection for obligation 2, independent of the fact that the numeric target of 7 conversations was reached.
Actual conversation count (1, then 7) never exceeded seven, so the 'more than seven' branch condition was never met and this line's action is excluded by workflow condition (rule 2).
Nested under the inactive L4 condition; the removal branch never applied since the count never exceeded seven.
